name: Guncati Grand
description: Nasledjuješ polugorak teren i 10 nedelja da organizuješ Grand Finale event — alociraš budžet, motivišeš volontere Tom Sawyer mehanikom, i 15 minuta real-time kulminacije koja sve dovodi po račun.

modules.src/config.js: Sve konstante: GC ekonomija, formule, volunteer tipovi, building tipovi, finale eventi
modules.src/state.js: Game state shape + save/load localStorage, state migration
modules.src/input.js: Click/touch event handlers, delegacija ka aktivnom screenu
modules.src/render.js: DOM screen routing, farm visualization update, frame manager
modules.src/systems/macro.js: Nedeljni budžet alokacija logika, category cap enforcement
modules.src/systems/micro.js: Volonterski task assignment engine, compatibility check, output calc
modules.src/systems/finale.js: Grand Finala real-time 15-min sim loop, event timing, DJ hype
modules.src/systems/economy.js: Revenue tracking, GC balance, building effects, weekly revenue calc
modules.src/systems/wellbeing.js: WB formula, decay po nedelji, TomSawyer prag (60%), combo cap
modules.src/systems/progression.js: Nedelja advance, building unlock check, volunteer pool expand
modules.src/systems/prestige.js: Stara Šaraga mode: reset + Reputation carry, prestige bonuses
modules.src/systems/events.js: Finale random event dispatcher, timing engine, effect application
modules.src/systems/checkpoint.js: Auto-save posle svake nedelje u localStorage
modules.src/systems/scoring.js: Final Score formula, win condition check, achievement unlock
modules.src/entities/volunteer.js: 7 volunteer tipova: statovi, task matrix, energija/glad/vibe decay
modules.src/entities/building.js: 5 building tipova × 3 levela: cene, efekti, unlock uslovi
modules.src/entities/dj.js: DJ slot entitet: hype kriva (+3%/min), transitions (±20%), slot sistem
modules.src/entities/crowd.js: Crowd entitet: capacity, mood formula, Crowd_Mood calculation
modules.src/ui/ui.js: Main UI coordinator, screen switching, DOM initialization
modules.src/ui/macro_ui.js: Nedeljni budžet panel: 4 category sliders, GC counter, building upgrade panel
modules.src/ui/micro_ui.js: Volonterski assignment grid: drag-drop ili klik, stat bars, compatibility hints
modules.src/ui/finale_ui.js: Real-time Finala HUD: Crowd Mood meter, DJ hype bar, event decision cards
modules.src/ui/hud.js: Persistent HUD: nedelja broj, GC balance, WB indicator, building status
modules.src/ui/modals.js: Onboarding modali (N1-N3), event decision popups, week result summary
modules.src/ui/score_ui.js: End screen: Final Score display, achievement badges, prestige unlock CTA
modules.src/audio.js: Web Audio API: ambient folk (jutro/rad/obrok/noć), event stingers, DJ hype ramp
modules.src/share.js: html2canvas screenshot + Web Share API, Final Score share card sa score i brand
modules.src/content/events_data.js: 10 Finale event definicija: trigger, opcije, efekti (tekst + delta vrednosti)
modules.src/content/volunteers_data.js: Volonterski flavor tekst, dijalozi, onboarding linije
modules.src/content/brand_hooks.js: Guncati/Kluboslavija/MKDSLend narativni fragmenti za tooltipe i ending
modules.index.html: ES6 module loader, DOM skeleton, CSS linkovi
modules.styles/base.css: Layout, full-screen responsive, panel grid, mobile breakpoints
modules.styles/ui.css: Panel dizajn: budget sliders, volunteer cards, building tiles, button stilovi
modules.styles/game.css: Farm animacije: building grow, WB pulse, crowd surge, event flash
